summary: Final evidence-anchoring supplement on the startup-blocking behaviour, no new claim. I re-read DefaultConfig to check the premise its conditions assert: config.go:330-340 sets MaxAppendEntries 64, TrailingLogs 10240 and SnapshotThreshold 8192, and the validation at config.go:368-376 bounds MaxAppendEntries to a positive value of at most 1024. The conditions are therefore tightened to name those source ranges and to say the boundary scales with the configured batch size, keeping the measured bracket (8402 entries / 132 batches not returning within 15 s versus 8002 entries / 126 batches returning in 0-3 ms) and the same execution indices. Nothing else in the record changes. Run state at expiry: four questions, each with complete violated comparisons and flag-off controls — restart configuration loss (witness 15, control 18), the stale multi-voter configuration loss with minority leadership, single-side and concurrent two-sided acknowledgements and post-heal log disagreement (22/25, 27/29, 27/29, 27/29), authority loss after restart (11/13), and NewRaft not returning with a large committed backlog against its sub-capacity control (9 vs 7) — plus one resolved gap, one retained durability negative at the two-second window, and knowledge entries for the restart configuration loss, the blocked startup, the authority loss, minority leadership, acknowledged minority writes, the post-heal disagreement and the durability negative.
